overall: Atlanta is in an active warming phase as of noon ET, with the running max already at 80.6°F and a strong heating rate of +5.4°F/hr still in play. With peak heating typically arriving between 2–4 PM local time, there are still several hours of meaningful temperature gain ahead.

max_temp_prediction: Given the current 80.6°F base at noon with +5.4°F/hr velocity, roughly 2–3 more hours of meaningful heating, and HRRR anchoring at 85.9°F, a daily high in the 85–87°F range is most probable.
